name: LabelSure
description: Intelligent Food Packaging Compliance & Nutritional Intelligence Platform
author: LabelSure Team

capabilities.name: Food vs Non-Food Classification
capabilities.description: Determines whether a scanned item is a food product, non-food item, or uncertain.

capabilities.name: Packaging OCR Field Extraction
capabilities.description: Extracts MRP, dates, batch numbers, net quantity, FSSAI licenses, and nutrition panels from packaging images.

capabilities.name: Statutory Compliance Audit
capabilities.description: Evaluates packaging declarations against the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Legal Metrology Rules, 2011.

capabilities.name: A+ to F Nutritional Grading
capabilities.description: Calculates health grades based on nutrient profiling thresholds.
